description: This file contains Kotlin source code implementing gateway configuration and parsing logic for an Android application. It defines data classes, enums, and functions related to resolving gateway URLs, handling setup codes, and configuring secure connections within the app.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a gateway endpoint including host, port, TLS and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Representation of a setup code containing a URL and optional tokens/password.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Configuration for connecting to a gateway, including host, port, security, and authentication tokens.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enumeration of validation errors related to gateway endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enumeration of input sources for gateway endpoint configuration.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Result of parsing a gateway endpoint URL, containing configuration or an error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Result of scanning and resolving a setup code, containing the code or an error.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Resolves a gateway connection configuration based on user input and saved data.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw gateway endpoint URL into configuration data.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Parses a gateway endpoint string into configuration data or an error.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded setup code into a structured object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Resolves a setup code obtained through scanning.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Provides the result of resolving a scanned setup code, including success or error.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly message based on endpoint validation error and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Constructs a manual gateway URL from host, port, and TLS setting.
